correctness.rationale: The support and normalization were checked: the B1 convolution has f0(0)=1 and Fourier spectrum (1+2x+2y)^2/5; orbit averaging gives mass 1+4(a+b+c). The exact 5th-root sample (cos 2pi/5, cos 4pi/5) yields 1-a-b-c>=0; when 12|n the (-1,1/2),(-1/2,0) inequalities average to the same bound. Root-of-unity equation 1+z+z^-1+w+w^-1=0 is governed by Lam-Leung short minimal vanishing sums: a 5-cycle requires 5|n; a 2+3 partition yields (-1,1/2) for 6|n or (0,-1/2) for 12|n. Thus outside 5 and 12 the canonical zero set is empty unless 6|n, when it contains exactly (-1,1/2) and swap. Empty set allows (1+eps)f0-eps delta0; the residual 6fold contacts allow (a,b,c)=(2/5+eps,1/5+3eps,2/5+eps), whose Fourier perturbation vanishes at both contacts and raises mass by 20eps. Finite grid compactness ensures positive eps at the other sampled pairs, proving strictness for every fixed n. Independently checked the exact n=6 rational Fourier witness (3/7,2/7,3/7) with mass 39/7 and independent 8-order zero diagnostics; these are supplementary to the all-n Lam-Leung proof.
residual_risks: Infinite classification depends on the published Lam-Leung minimal root-of-unity theorem, not on the n<=240 numerical checker; theorem does not compute optimal values when T_n>5.

value.rationale: Natural arithmetic-optimality boundary for canonical 5-point cross-autocorrelation on 13-point Lee two-balls. It separates exact packing/spectral equality from strict gains at every torus size and identifies surprising 5fold and 12fold resonances, while distinguishing 6fold contacts that do not suffice. This is a motivated nonroutine finite-group extremal theorem, not a random parameter substitution or sole checker output.
residual_risks: Does not calculate how much the mass exceeds five for remaining n; that limitation does not erase the exact equality classification.

final_claim: For every n>=5 the counting-normalized positive-definite Turán mass of the 13-point Lee radius-two ball B1-B1 in (Z/n)^2 equals 5 exactly when 5|n or 12|n, and strictly exceeds 5 otherwise.
limitations: Finite diagnostic n<=240 and exact n=6 test are not used as an all-n proof.
The endpoint determines exactly when T_n=5, not its strict-excess values or all optimizers.
